answer_1.quote: We evaluate BOOKWORLD via story generation... When the simulation ends, the simulation records are applied to LLMs to rephrase the records into the final, novel-style story.
datasets: A Song of Ice and Fire series

answer_2.quote: we adopt pairwise comparison across multiple dimensions between the stories generated by different methods... The final results are evaluated using gpt-4o-2024-08-06.

answer_3.quote: Each output from any two methods undergoes paired comparison, with LLMs determining superior performance.

answer_4.quote: We recruit 5 human annotators (Fans of the corresponding work) to evaluate the outputs from our proposed method and the baseline approach across five dimensions.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to indicate which method performed better on each evaluation dimension.
